ul.li: Separate API and Web App as much as possible to make Blazor exchangable later (e.g. Vue, Tailwind)
Initial Distance mod can only open Distags for the current level in a browser (Steam overlay or default Browser)
CQRS for a straightforward entry point for all data-reading and -writing use-cases
No separate Repository and UnitOfWork abstraction - DbContext is sufficient
Levels are identified by slug (official levels) or their workshop ID (workshop levels)
Levels database IDs are internal only
Official level images are hosted by the API
